#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec3 aPointInfo; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; uniform vec2 dim; uniform vec2 offs; uniform float depth; out vec4 fragTexCoord; out vec2 fragCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPointInfo.xy + aRectPoint.xy * aPointInfo.z, depth, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); fragTexCoord.xy = (offs.xy + aPointInfo.xy) * dim; fragTexCoord.zw = vec2(aRectPoint.z) * dim; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; uniform sampler2D sampler0; uniform float alpha; in vec4 fragTexCoord; in vec2 fragCoord; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { vec2 tc = fragTexCoord.xy + fragTexCoord.zw * (vec2(fragCoord.x, 1.0 - fragCoord.y) - vec2(0.5)); vec4 color = texture(sampler0, tc); float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float pixelDist = fwidth(dist) * 1.0; float smoothAlpha = 1.0 - clamp((dist - (radius - pixelDist)) / pixelDist, 0.0, 1.0); FragColor = vec4(color.xyz, 1.0) * alpha * smoothAlpha; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec3 aPointInfo; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPointInfo.xy + aRectPoint.xy * aPointInfo.z, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; in vec2 fragCoord; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float pixelDist = fwidth(dist) * 1.0; float smoothAlpha = 1.0 - clamp((dist - (radius - pixelDist)) / pixelDist, 0.0, 1.0); FragColor = vec4(0, 0.0, 0.0, smoothAlpha); }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; in vec4 position; out vec2 vUV; void main(void) { gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); vUV = position.zw; }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; in vec2 vUV; uniform sampler2D StrokeTexture; uniform sampler2D MaskBitmap; uniform vec4 inputColor; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float strokeAlpha = texture(StrokeTexture, vUV).a; if (strokeAlpha > 0.0) FragColor = vec4(inputColor.rgb, strokeAlpha * inputColor.a); else discard; }

attribute vec4 position; uniform mat4 ObjectTransformMatrix; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; uniform mat4 TextureTransform; varying vec2 texCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * ObjectTransformMatrix * vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); texCoord = (TextureTransform * vec4(position.zw, 0.0, 1.0)).xy; }
precision highp float; precision mediump int; varying vec2 texCoord; uniform sampler2D sampler0; void main(void) { gl_FragColor = texture2D(sampler0, texCoord); }

precision highp float; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; attribute vec3 aVertex; varying float alphaAA; void main(void) { gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aVertex.xy, 0.0, 1.0); alphaAA = aVertex.z; }

precision mediump float; varying float alphaAA; uniform vec4 uColor; uniform vec4 uTintColor; uniform int uHasTintColor; void main(void) { float alpha = alphaAA * uColor.a; if (uHasTintColor == 1) { alpha *= uTintColor.a; gl_FragColor = vec4(uTintColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); } else { gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); } }
